environment.binary_provenance: guarded follow-up cargo build -p tokenzero --release after SHA reuse; 100MiB single and 4-way rows refreshed; 1/10MiB rows retain prior candidate run

method.analysis: One materialized UTF-8 payload is required for response processing; a second inline recovery payload is not required when path and exact range are stable. mmap was rejected because response ownership still materializes and truncation safety would add complexity without reducing that allocation.
method.concurrent_command: four simultaneous /usr/bin/time -l tokenzero subprocesses, separate recovery caches
method.corpus: deterministic repeated UTF-8 lines; exact byte lengths
method.refresh_scope: 100MiB single and 4x100MiB rows rerun once after reusing canonical SHA-256 for fingerprint/legacy alias and incrementally hashing file refs; 1/10MiB rows unchanged from prior candidate

concurrent_4x_100mb.ceiling_definition: sum of /usr/bin/time -l per-process maxima; conservative because peaks may not coincide
